sourceTitle: Sun Dried Tomato Goat Cheese Dip Recipe
sourceText:
Sun Dried Tomato Goat Cheese Dip Recipe
By: Holly Sander
Published: Friday, June 24, 2016 - 12:34pm

Ingredients




3 green onions, chopped (reserve 1 tablespoon for garnish)
⅓ cup original unsweetened almond milk
10.5 ounces goat cheese
8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes in oil (I prefer Bella Sun Luci brand)
½ teaspoon salt
½ teaspoon pepper
2 large garlic cloves, minced

Preparation

1 Add all the ingredients into the food processor. 2 Process until all ingredients are fully incorporated. Texture should be firm but spreadable, like a soft cream cheese. (If too thick add another tablespoon of almond milk.) 3 Garnish with reserved green onions. 4 Serve with fresh vegetables, crackers or pretzel chips.

About

Sun-Dried Tomato Goat Cheese Dip: An awesome summer appetizer! Serve with fresh veggies. With sun-dried tomatoes, goat cheese, scallions, almond milk, & garlic.
Please visit my blog Taste and See for more delicious recipes!
